layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Quadruped Sauropod legs
features: Four thick, pillar-like legs made of smooth clay
Wide elephant-like feet with rounded blunt toes
Tactile clay sculpture texture with soft wrinkles at the joints
Clear view of all four legs to emphasize quadrupedalism
layer_3_action.action: A low-angle extreme close-up focusing on the four feet of a large, friendly dinosaur. The front feet and back feet are all visible as they stand in a lush fern meadow with small muddy puddles. Deep, round footprints are visible in the clay-like earth. The background features soft-focus Araucaria and Ginkgo trees. No text.
